description: This 3D bar chart visualizes the accuracy of three large language models—Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD—across two distinct tasks labeled “Classification” and “Generation,” with accuracy serving as the vertical axis, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2. The horizontal axis represents the models (Davinci-003, ChatGPT, BARD), while the depth axis represents the task type (Classification, Generation). Each model has two bars: one for Classification and one for Generation. The bars are colored with a gradient from blue (lower values) to yellow (higher values), indicating the level of accuracy. For Davinci-003, the Classification bar reaches approximately 0.5 accuracy, while the Generation bar is shorter, at about 0.3. For ChatGPT, the Classification bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 0.8, and the Generation bar is slightly shorter, around 0.7. For BARD, the Classification bar is approximately 0.6, and the Generation bar is shorter, around 0.4. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model names as labeled. There are no visual emphasis or annotations on any specific bars.
